name: sonic-match-studio
description: Sonic Match Studio — Windows desktop Build Set window

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron . --dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit
